component.name: Lift Elite Control
component.summary: Configure the NZXT Lift Elite mouse
Configura il mouse NZXT Lift Elite

description.p: Unofficial tool to edit the five onboard profiles of the NZXT Lift Elite: DPI stages, polling rate, lift-off distance, motion sync, profile LED colour and button mapping, through the cable or the 2.4 GHz receiver. Not affiliated with NZXT.
